notes.threshold: Per-file 100% on statements, branches, functions and lines (see vitest.config.js). These six files hold invariants that have silently broken in this repo before: the homepage lead, reader-facing render dates, release verification, published record counts, the route table, and the outreach send gate.
notes.daily-digest.js: Not listed here, but not untested. The entitlement gate and grace-window logic are exported pure functions covered by functions/cron/daily-digest.test.js. The request handler around them is covered by scripts/planning-digest.regression.mjs, which drives it against a real in-memory SQLite D1. That suite runs under `node --test` — a separate CI gate — so vitest's v8 coverage cannot see it. A low vitest figure for this file reflects where the tests run, not a coverage gap.
notes.manage.js: Same shape. resolveDeliveryState is unit-tested in functions/api/alerts/manage.test.js; the handler is exercised by the regression suite.
notes.adding_files: Before adding a file here, confirm it is genuinely uncovered rather than covered from the regression suite. Run: npx vitest run --coverage, then read the per-file row.
